entities.summary: The Battle of the Yalu River lasted from April 30 to May 1, 1904 and was the first major land battle during the Russo-Japanese War. It was fought near Wiju on the lower reaches of the Yalu River, on the border between Korea and China. Also known as the Yalu River Crossing Operation.
